findings: Opening requires a successful known-usage model receipt matching reconstructed request digest, exactly one own entry user message, and exact open tool parameter schema. Expanded recovery tools are barred in entry acknowledgements.
Opening is staged until next prepare. A failed prepare or acknowledgement revokes wrapper access; corrupt archived captures fail closed on expansion and staged opening survives source repair.

Expanded mode persists and delegates immutable-snapshot paging, original-body recovery, handle validation and refresh-at-end to unchanged underlying session. Each prepared expanded page requires a new acknowledged request.
Returned state is cloned; synchronous state transitions and preparation busy guard prevent mid-batch tool-set changes.
All 37 fixture reads remain reachable across acknowledged pages, including after caller live-context eviction; retained archive and persistent controller remain caller obligations.
limitations: Candidate controller only: no episode, persistence, tokenizer, dispatch or cancellation integration is approved.
Cold entry intentionally does not validate the archive; source-complete preflight remains mandatory.
Raw duplicate JSON argument-key rejection belongs to integration before decoded arguments enter this controller.
Restart persistence is absent and must not reset expanded state in an active trajectory.
Byte-based test measurement does not establish provider token bounds, savings, discovery quality or perfection.
actual_archive_caveat: The prior treatment presented a pinned initially empty catalog in every recorded recovery presentation. Zero recovery calls therefore does not evaluate the utility of a populated catalog. Demand recovery changes first-snapshot timing as well as initial representation, and still requires explicit refresh once expanded.
